correctness.rationale: Lagrange evaluation makes uniform degree<q f identical to independent uniform values f(x). Missing value indicators I_u and J_v have independent-across-x joint exclusion at x equal a=(q-1)/q when h(x)=v-u, otherwise b=(q-2)/q. With r_c counts, E[I_u J_v]=a^{r_c}b^{q-r_c}, q pairs u,v per c, giving Cov=q sum_c a^{r_c} b^{q-r_c}-q²a^{2q}. Discrete second differences for Phi(t)=a^t b^{q-t} equal (a-b)^2 a^t b^{q-t-2}>0 for q>=3; at q=2 Phi=(0,0,1/4) also strictly convex. Elementary majorization gives min profile (1,...,1) exactly h permutation and max (q,0,...,0) exactly h constant. Schur adjacent transfers yield first nontrivial gaps b^{q-2}/q at (2,1...,1,0) and a^{q-1}-b^{q-1} at (q-1,1,0...) for q>=3. Negative min uses log estimate; max equals strictly positive variance under constant translate. Independent exact enumeration of all f,h q=2,3,4 validates covariance and profiles; proof covers all prime powers and arbitrary h polynomial function.
